_readme: The ONE place to edit services. Set "published": false to hide a service everywhere (menus, pages, contact form). Change "order" to reorder. "slug" becomes the web address: /services/<slug>/. Allowed icons: headset, phone-out, target, calendar, trend, chat, assistant, documents. Copy is a draft: keep only what you actually offer.

services.title: Inbound Customer Support
services.summary: Answer customer calls in your brand's voice, resolve questions and route issues to the right place.
services.intro: Your customers call with questions, orders and problems. We answer as an extension of your team, follow your scripts and escalation rules, and log every interaction the way you need it.
includes: Answering inbound calls during the hours you choose
Order, account and general enquiry handling
Ticket logging in your help desk or CRM
Escalation to your team using your rules
Call notes and regular activity reports
goodFit: Growing businesses whose call volume has outpaced their in-house team
Teams that need cover outside their own office hours

services.title: Outbound Calling
services.summary: Proactive calls for follow-ups, reminders, surveys, renewals and customer win-back.
services.intro: Outbound calls work best when they are planned, polite and measured. We agree the goal, script and call lists with you, then report on every outcome.
includes: Call outcomes recorded against each contact
Campaign summaries you can act on
goodFit: Businesses with a contact list and a clear call objective
Teams that want calls made without hiring and training in-house

services.title: Lead Generation
services.summary: Find and qualify prospects that match your ideal customer, so your sales team talks to the right people.
services.intro: We work from your ideal customer profile to research, contact and qualify prospects, then pass on the ones that meet the criteria you set.
includes: Prospect research against your ideal customer profile
Initial outreach by phone and email
Qualified leads delivered into your CRM or a shared sheet
Feedback on which messages and segments respond
goodFit: B2B companies that need a steadier flow of qualified conversations
Sales teams that want to spend their time on closing

services.title: Appointment Setting
services.summary: Book qualified meetings straight into your team's calendars.
services.intro: We contact interested prospects, confirm they meet your criteria and book a time that works for both sides, with reminders to reduce no-shows.
includes: Booking meetings directly into your calendars
Clear reporting on meetings booked and held
goodFit: Sales and consulting teams whose calendars should be full of the right meetings
Businesses running events, demos or consultations

services.title: Sales Development Support
services.summary: Extra hands for your sales pipeline: research, outreach sequences, CRM updates and follow-ups.
services.intro: We support your sales team with the time-consuming groundwork, so deals keep moving and nothing falls through the cracks.
includes: Keeping CRM records accurate and up to date
goodFit: Sales teams with more pipeline work than people
Founders who are still doing their own outreach

services.title: Email and Live Chat Support
services.summary: Written support that is quick, accurate and on-brand, across email and website chat.
services.intro: Many customers prefer to write rather than call. We handle your support inbox and live chat using your tone of voice, templates and knowledge base.
includes: Live chat on your website or app
Response templates written in your brand voice
Tagging and routing in your help desk
Updates to your knowledge base when gaps appear
goodFit: Teams whose inbox has become a backlog

services.title: Virtual Assistance
services.summary: Reliable day-to-day admin support: inbox, calendar, research and routine tasks.
services.intro: Hand over the recurring admin that takes you away from the work only you can do. We agree clear tasks, access and checkpoints before we start.
goodFit: Businesses that need flexible admin help

services.title: Back-Office Support and Data Processing
services.summary: Accurate data entry, document processing and back-office tasks, done to your standards.
services.intro: Behind every customer interaction is a stack of records to keep right. We take on structured back-office work with agreed accuracy checks.
goodFit: Operations teams with high-volume, rules-based tasks
Businesses digitising paper or spreadsheet records
